0022600132.text: Atlanta hosts Miami in the Hawks' fifth game of the season, with the Hawks at 2-1, first in the Southeast and 3rd in the East, coming off a loss, while the 0-3 Heat are on a three-game losing streak and 15th in the East. Atlanta is 0-1 at home and 2-0 on the road, Miami is 0-2 at home and 0-1 on the road, and the Heat sit fifth in the Southeast, 2 games back, while Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) are out for the Hawks. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Hawks lost the 2025-26 series 1-3, including a 143-117 loss in Miami on April 12, 2026.
